name: Ichimiya Sei
source:
Hobby: Playing Piano

A 2nd year at Shoukei Academy.
A calm guy with slippery personality that makes it hard to understand what he's thinking.
He has a delicate appearance, but he really loves woman, he's also a genius pianist.
